content.label:
This app has motivated me to get into healthy habits! If you’re someone who finds it hard to motivate yourself, this app is definitely for you!

Someone who also reviewed this app (which was the review that convinced me to get the app) said that if you love doing streaks on Snapchat, this will be for you! And they were right!

I will add, as a suggestion to improve the app, is that when there is an entry for “read a book” or “brush teeth”.. the timer has to time out to complete the habit and continue the streak. I’ve sometimes been too busy to start the timer whilst brushing my teeth, so I have to start the timer later on or sometimes forget to start it up. A suggestion is to have a choice of either holding down the habit to complete the habit or to still select the timer. 

This app is amazing!

title.label: Streaks has made me a better person! 🥳

content.label: The power of streaks is truely something special, and this app help’s highlight how far I’ve come when I set out to achieve something. I’ve lost weight, learnt skills and read more books because of this app and I really appreciate its existence. Thank you!

Very nice app, easy to use and really helpful 
Just one things , when I create a task, I would like to add the goal or the timer, only available for preset tasks
THEY ASKED SO HERE IT IS

I’ve scoured the App Store for applications like these. This stood out though and it is worth the money.

Many other apps need subscriptions but this app is superior because it isn’t necessary to do so and that’s why I love this app.

There are so many ways to make use of this app! I love that I can set so many different kinds of goals and how I can track my progress! - From exercise routines to skill practice, to prioritising time for myself or time spent working with my kids HW or skill development. I can track application to chores or supporting health. 
I can choose time lengths to discipline myself to a task, or multiple counts of a task per day/week/month etc.
I can adjust how many times per day in how many days per week. I can choose which days in a week I specifically want to complete a task. 
It pings you with positive encouragement for achieving goals, you can choose from a vast variety of colour combinations to personalise it (including allowing the background to change at random or using light/dark mode) and you can archive goals you made, but don’t want to delete them (insteadsuspend them for a time).

I even love the different symbols you can choose from to match each of your tasks - making it easier to find the one you want to check off.
Also, best addition I found is when it started syncing to my Apple Watch! *I can check off items without even opening my phone.

If you like checklists, setting or tracking history of any goals or find you are really busy— this app will make life easier. (The calendar in the app even allows you to open it and fix any errors you entered or if you forgot to check off a previous day.)

*I just recommend taking the time to explore its options and try a couple of ways to count your goals. (Sometimes I found that one way of using the app was not as helpful as another, but I can always edit it.)

title.label: Love it, but please only show habits on the days they are active

content.label: If my habit is configured for Monday to Friday, please hide it on weekends.

It definitely keeps me motivated and accountable. Well worth the money. Would like more options available though as it’s limited to only 24, a few more for less frequent tasks like cleaning etc would make this app perfect.

If you want to spend your time jabbing hopelessly at the screen while the app bumbles along in a repetitive loop then get this app.  Otherwise look elsewhere. I can’t believe an app can be so incompetently written in this day and age. I spent good money on this on a flawed recommendation and regret it immensely.

Love it.

Habit tracking, when made simple and automatic like this, really does have the potential to put you on track to becoming a more productive and healthier version of yourself. Couldn’t be more satisfied- single best purchase for my iPhone.
Unfortunately it’s not a great app. Don’t waste your money.

Visually stunning… 

Best streaks/momentum app I’ve used (I’ve tried a fair few) - as can adapt to longer term goals eg 3 times a week versus daily activities- 

Thanks!

I started using this after reading James Cleat’s Atomic Habits. I set myself up four days ago & have maintained my “streaks” on everything, far beyond what I would have previously done. I observe myself finding the extra 5 minutes to close something in situations where last week I wouldn’t have. Really like the Apple Watch interface as well.

It’s simple, easy to use and doesn’t seem to have any bugs. My only suggestion to the developers would be to have step-by-step tutorials as it did take a bit of fiddling to get the tasks I wanted to track set up.
Thanks

I’ve been using streak for a few years now and it has helped me break a few bad habits (smoking, sugar etc) and developed many good habit (waking up early, exercise, reading etc). Key point is that you have to be honest to yourself. I have many time been on a good streak, missed a task and wanted to just press the button just to say that I’ve done it. It better to be honest and start on square 1 again. Once you can string together like 40-60 days together, it’s now a new habit and you can replace with a new habit you want to form. Have fun!
Would love if you could let us add even more than 24 tasks :)

title.label: I love this app! Simple and beautiful! Worth the cost! :)

I use a home screen widget with it to keep a reminder of how I’m going with my tasks.

This app is worth the price. It’s simple and elegant and works. I highly highly recommend it. 

:)))))

title.label: Absolutely LOVE this App for motivation!

content.label: I stumbled across Streaks when I was looking for reviews on a totally unrelated App six months ago. Saw a few good reviews, thought I’d give it a go. Used it for a couple of months, but then mostly forgot about it. But about six weeks ago, I revisited it, completely overhauled my task list, and how I was using the App - and now it is my go to App every single day. I LOVE how it motivates and helps keep me focused. It works perfectly with the Apple Watch. I use it for keeping very specific areas of my life on track, and it’s brilliant for that. It’s so much more than just a ‘to do list’. It really does help you to form new habits. Huge thank you to the developers of this little gem. May you never stop supporting it.

I couldn’t add a task to repeat on a specific day every two weeks; I couldn’t pause a streak (e.g. if I was out of town and couldn’t do to the gym); and I couldn’t set tasks to fall in particular parts of the day (e.g. for a whole range of tasks I do just before going to bed). I won’t be using it any more, so I’m frustrated there wasn’t a trial version to try out before paying for the app.

The goals/ habits have the ability to set a timer to track how long you complete a task for. However, the timer resets at the end of the day. Therefore, if you want to time you Intermittent Fasting (IF) from you evening meal to the following day it will not work. 

For example, if I wanted to fast for 16 hours starting Monday at 19:30 until Tuesday at 11:30 it will not work. I’ll wake up and see that the timer has been cleared.

This is especially disappointing as I purchased the app based on a very good rating. Clearly I should have looked into it further before committing to an app.
Integration of data sources is great but visualisation of progress needs to be simpler. Back to Momentum.
